name: Grid Run
description: grid_run: Start a new operation on this venue or the selected execution venue and wait for its output. Use asynchronous submission when you need a Job handle immediately. To inspect or await work already submitted, use the advertised Job tools. Each invocation starts new work. Requires invoke permission on the operation reference and the operation's own resource permissions.

operation.description: Exact operation reference from catalog metadata, configuration or the task: v/ops/<group>/<op>, o/<pin>, a/<hash>, a hex asset hash, or a DID URL. Resolve it on the execution venue. A DID URL selects where to fetch a definition, not where to execute it. Never derive a catalog path from a tool name.

input.description: Arguments matching the target operation's input schema; any JSON value. Inspect unfamiliar operations' metadata before invoking them. Passed unchanged, including strings that look like JSON.

venue.description: Execution venue HTTP(S) URL or routable DID. Omit to use this operation's default venue, normally the current venue. This input overrides any definition-level venue. Null is invalid. Retain the selected venue when following the returned Job.

authenticateAs.description: Remote identity: anonymous (default) sends no identity or grants; caller requires your identity credential addressed to the target venue, with no capabilities, plus any separate grants; venue is only for the venue itself. Use the same mode and credentials when following the Job. Local calls retain your caller context.

output.description: The operation's output (shape determined by the operation's output schema)
